purpose: Test materially different daily ETF mechanisms independently before considering any regime router or combination.

candidates.mechanism: risk-balanced allocation without a return forecast

execution.signal_at: session close using only then-available data

decision_policy: No candidate is eligible for promotion from retrospective performance alone. Evaluate return, drawdown, risk-adjusted performance, turnover/cost sensitivity, rolling windows, walk-forward folds, and causal market-condition scorecards.
